title: Default member initialization
recap: Default member initializers specify fallback values in the type definition. Aggregate initialization uses those defaults for members not explicitly initialized.
Create a default-configured object and override only the requested field. This avoids coupling a small override to every default in the type.
objectives: Implement the stated behavior for multiple inputs.
Run the visible tests and explain one boundary case.
warnings: The function/type interface is fixed, but implementation syntax is your choice.
Do not remove the visible tests; the checker keeps an independent copy.
Respect the stated input domain and lifetime/range rules.
challenge: Implement configured(retries). Return a Connection using its default timeout=30 and secure=true. If retries >= 0 override only retries; for negative retries keep its default of 3. The struct's defaults are already declared and should be used rather than replacing unrelated fields with zero.
hints: Only nonnegative retry counts override the default.
Do not change timeout or secure.
